channel.title: The Awesome Ledger — awesome-detection-engineering
channel.description: New entries across the GitHub awesome ecosystem, diffed nightly.

item.title: Control Assurance Lab | Gyubin Lee — via awesome-detection-engineering
item.description: Runs reproducible matched-intervention experiments that distinguish target-control failures from failures masked by downstream safeguards.

item.title: Clankerusecase — via awesome-detection-engineering
item.description: Threat-led library of 7,800+ MITRE ATT&CK-mapped detections in Defender/Sentinel KQL, Sigma, Splunk SPL, Datadog, Falcon LogScale, and AWS CloudWatch, generated from public threat-intel reporting and schema-validated before publish.

item.title: Security Monitoring Labs | cybersecurity101.net — via awesome-detection-engineering
item.description: 48 free, step-by-step labs that build a small Wazuh monitoring stack on your own VMs, connect Linux and Windows (Sysmon) log sources, then write and tune detection rules, test them with simulated events, triage alerts and report on coverage. No account or hosted platform.

item.title: Ridgeline Detection Library — via awesome-detection-engineering
item.description: Production-validated detections across nine platforms (KQL, Sigma, Splunk, Athena, PowerShell, Velociraptor, YARA, Suricata, osquery), each with triggers, false positives, tuning guidance, and validation steps. Apache-2.0.

item.title: ZettelForge — via awesome-detection-engineering
item.description: Agentic memory system that treats Sigma and YARA rules as first-class memory entities, with an LLM rule explainer, STIX 2.1 knowledge graph of CTI entities, and offline-first RAG to connect rules to the actors and techniques they detect. Python, MIT.

item.title: ThreatMapper | Andrey Pautov — via awesome-detection-engineering
item.description: CTI-to-detection workbench for mapping threat reports to ATT&CK, comparing TTP overlap with groups and campaigns, identifying detection gaps, and exporting analyst-ready outputs.

item.title: InnerWarden — via awesome-detection-engineering
item.description: Autonomous security agent for Linux with real-time threat detection and response via 38 eBPF hooks, 48 detectors, and 23 correlation rules.

item.title: Elastic's Detection Engineering Behavior Maturity Model — via awesome-detection-engineering
item.description: Elastic's qualitative and quantitative approach to measuring threat detection program maturity.
